text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gahhh! This sucks! I thought I had it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But what a great race! Beating me is a pretty big deal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It feels great to run against such formidable opponents! My tail is still quiverin' with adrenaline!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I was clearly out of my depth, which sucks, but it was a battle to remember.
choice_data_list: You've got the next one for sure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I thought I had it in me to pull through, but that was just naive thinking. Now that it's come to this, there's only one thing I can do…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And that's to move my body like there's no tomorrow! Time to do some running to clear my mind!
choice_data_list: But you just finished a race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so now I gotta do a post-race run! Time to book it all the way home! Raaaah!
I hurry after her, but I can't keep up with Hishi Amazon sprinting at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It goes without sayin' that I'll never give up, no matter how good my opponents are!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Every second I'm not eating or sleeping, I'm gonna be training! Or y'know what? Forget sleeping too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, whatever! I'm just saying that's how far I'm willin' to go! I gotta keep training to secure that next win!
